## Important Caveats

- Public pages provide high-level capability and workflow descriptions.
- Detailed CLI references for Contbrun/Contestbed/TBini are not fully published publicly.
- Full technical manuals and command-level guides are typically license-portal content.

## Agent Policy Implications

- Prefer local LDRA CLI help captures under `.github/instructions/` for command behavior.
- Use MCP tooling as source of truth for execution and exit codes.
- Do not fabricate LDRA reports; only consume artifacts actually generated by LDRA.
